rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an imprudent act or bad decision.

example.english: This investment was an indiscretion, and it made everyone lose money.
example.traditional: 今次投資失策，搞到成班人都蝕咗錢。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 tau4 zi1 sat1 caak3 gaau2 dou3 sing4 baan1 jan4 dou1 sit6 zo2 cin4

rows.note: Use this when the indiscretion is specifically something inappropriate that someone said.

example.english: Their comment was an indiscretion: they criticized their boss in front of everyone.
example.traditional: 佢一時失言，當住咁多人面批評上司。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 si4 sat1 jin4 dong1 zyu6 gam3 do1 jan4 min6 pai1 ping4 soeng6 si1

rows.note: Use this more formal term for general carelessness or an act resulting from insufficient caution.

example.english: The accident resulted from an indiscretion while operating the machine.
example.traditional: 意外係由於操作機器時不慎造成嘅。
example.jyutping: ji3 ngoi6 hai6 jau4 jyu1 cou1 zok3 gei1 hei3 si4 bat1 san6 zou6 sing4 ge3
